links.why: כִּי after the verb of seeing: 'he saw that the light was good'. The clause is what God saw, the object of the verb, not a reason.
Direction reversed. The narrative runs from the seeing (cl0) to the separating (cl2); cl2 does not precede cl0.
wayyiqtol cl2 continues the narrative line from the seeing in cl0. The that-clause cl1 is the object of that seeing, not a speech, and does not break the line.

cant_tell.why: The field holds a parser code (o010010040051), not a conjunction. The כִּי appears in the gloss as 'that', so the that-link is decided from the gloss.
